description: Creates an API token for a project or for the organization, with its permissions, its environments and its lifetime; it is returned only once. Not by an agent connected through OAuth: a person creates it in while.

days.description: Lifetime in days (30 by default, 0 without expiry).

environments.description: Where it can act (production, previews, or names); without a list, everywhere.

organization.description: For an organization token: its name; optional with an organization token.

name: create_token
title: Create an API token
